```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse,posterior, bayesplot, tidybayes,
               brms, patchwork, cowplot,ggpubr,flextable)


invisible(lapply(
  list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling", "utility"), full.names = TRUE),
  function(f) source(f, echo = FALSE, print.eval = FALSE)
))

```

## Extracting the data:

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
df = load_data()
```


## plotting the behavioral data:
```{r, fig.height=6,fig.width=8, message=F,warning=F}
plot_beh_data(df,NULL,F)

plot_beh_data_tog(df %>% filter(Trialtype == "Main"), NULL, F)

plot_beh_data_tog(df %>% mutate(subject = as.numeric(as.factor(subject))) %>% 
  filter(subject %in% 1:11) %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf") %>% drop_na(), 6, F)
```

# posterior predictives:

```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6, error=F,message=F,warning=F}
pps = pp_hier(fit_hier, dd, n_bins = 10)

pps[[1]]
```


```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6, error=F,message=F,warning=F}
pps[[2]]
```


```{r,fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Arrange in a 2-row × 4-column grid, collect all legends
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(pps[[2]], ncol = 4, nrow = 2, guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect")

combined_plot = combined_plot+theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
                       axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
                       axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"))


combined_plot


ggsave(here::here("Preregistration","Figures","Pilot_predictive_checks.PNG"),dpi = 300, height = 12, width = 18)

```
